title: How to Diagnose a Widget Overload in Under 5 Minutes

outline.heading: The fix

plainText:
Symptoms of overload
Widgets can overload for many reasons. It is important to pay attention to your widget and notice if something seems wrong. Many experts agree that overload is a common issue in the industry today.

The fix
There are many ways to fix a widget. You should try different things and see what works best for your situation. Everyone's widget is different so results may vary.
